title: ZeroDiff: Zero-Shot Time Series Reconstruction via Informed-Prior Diffusion
abstract: arXiv:2609.37078v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Time series modeling increasingly demands high-quality supervision, yet target observations remain scarce - exogenous inputs are broadly available, but target measurements are often unavailable due to cost, infrastructure, or accessibility constraints. Can models trained on observed locations reconstruct target time series where measurements have never been collected? We term this zero-shot time series reconstruction. A naive approach - directly mapping exogenous inputs to targets - can yield predictions at unobserved locations, but without target signals, such models fail to capture the intrinsic dynamics of the target variable, producing overly smooth outputs that underestimate extremes. This reveals systematic errors that call for explicit modeling and calibration. translated_title: ZeroDiff：基于信息先验扩散的零样本时间序列重建
translated_abstract: 时间序列建模越来越需要高质量的监督信号，然而目标观测数据仍然稀缺——外生输入广泛可得，但目标变量的测量数据由于成本、基础设施或可及性等限制往往无法获得。在观测位置训练的模型能否重建从未收集过测量数据的目标时间序列？我们将这一问题称为零样本时间序列重建。一种简单的方法是直接将外生输入映射到目标，这虽然可以在未观测位置产生预测，但由于缺乏目标信号，此类模型无法捕捉目标变量的内在动态，产生过度平滑、低估极值的输出。这揭示了需要显式建模和校准的系统性误差。我们提出ZeroDiff，它仅从外生变量构建信息先验，然后通过扩散模型学习校准重建误差——在观测位置上进行训练。
tldr: ZeroDiff提出了一种零样本时间序列重建方法，仅利用外生变量构建信息先验，并通过扩散模型校准重建误差，从而在从未收集过目标测量数据的位置也能重建高质量的目标时间序列。
en_tdlr: ZeroDiff enables zero-shot time series reconstruction by constructing an informed prior solely from exogenous variables and learning to calibrate reconstruction errors through diffusion, producing high-quality target time series at locations where measurements have never been collected.
